name: Survivor

source.note: Entered from published reviews and guides to Ravenloft: The Horrors Within (and Van Richten's Guide to Ravenloft, which it revises); compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

summary: Reroll an Initiative of 9 or lower, and once per Long Rest add your Proficiency Bonus to a save against being Charmed or Frightened.

benefits.name: Ever Watchful
benefits.summary: When your Initiative d20 shows 9 or lower, reroll it and use the new roll.
benefits.text: When you roll Initiative and the d20 shows 9 or lower, you can reroll it, and you must use the new roll.

benefits.name: Steeled Nerves
benefits.summary: Reaction, once per Long Rest: add your Proficiency Bonus to a save against Charmed or Frightened.
benefits.text: When you make a saving throw to avoid or end the Charmed or Frightened condition, you can take a Reaction to add your Proficiency Bonus to the roll. Once you do, you can't again until you finish a Long Rest.
